description:
Where the workspace's own site ranks in Google for the keywords it tracks, measured daily by Refora (desktop, organic results, top 20): position, 7-day change, the ranking URL, whether Google showed an AI Overview and whether it cites the site, other places on the page the site appears (image pack, local pack...), the best-placed competitor, search volume and difficulty, plus the overall search visibility.

Use when the user asks about Google rankings, SEO positions or classic search -- phrases like 'where do we rank for X', 'which keywords dropped', 'do AI Overviews cite us in Google'. Needs the SEO add-on.

A null position after a check means 'not in the top N' (`not_in_top`), never 'not checked'.

Example: 'Which of our keywords are on page one in Google?'
